dataset.name: Treatment-naive SCLC cohort (GSE60052)
dataset.description: Independent Chinese small-cell lung-cancer cohort restricted to primary tumors collected before chemotherapy, with bulk RNA sequencing and individual overall survival.
dataset.cohort_context: The source matrix contains 79 SCLC tumors and seven normal lungs. TRACE Explorer links only source-flagged tumor RNA profiles to Table S1, excludes all normals, excludes post-chemotherapy specimens and removes one patient whose two source tumor columns cannot be ranked from public evidence.

metadata.source_program: Chinese surgically resected SCLC genomic landscape study
metadata.source_data_system: NCBI GEO plus the CC BY 4.0 PLOS Genetics clinical supplement
metadata.sample_selection_note: Patient 10-5656 has two eligible-looking matrix columns, B10-5656A and T10-5656A, without a public rule that identifies the intended profile. Both columns and the patient are excluded rather than selected arbitrarily.
metadata.treatment_note: The primary release contains only Naive specimens. Eight post-chemotherapy patients are not pooled with it and are too few to satisfy TRACE's minimum ten-patient release rule.
metadata.normal_tissue_note: All seven normal-lung columns are excluded before clinical linkage and can never be used as fallback samples.
metadata.selection_bias_note: The cohort was assembled from resected tumors and is enriched for surgically accessible disease; it should not be interpreted as representative of all SCLC presentations.
metadata.clinical_coding_note: Source gender and smoking codes are retained in provenance but are not exposed as structured covariates because their 1/2 coding is not defined unambiguously in the public supplement.

samples.sample_role: Primary SCLC tumor collected before chemotherapy

expression.label: Provided DESeq-normalized log2 expression
expression.mapping_source: Source-provided gene symbols in the pinned GSE60052 matrix
expression.duplicate_feature_rationale: All 51,131 source gene symbols are non-empty and unique; no aggregation is applied.
expression.scale_note: GEO and the source filename identify the matrix as DESeq-normalized log2 expression. TRACE preserves the published scale without applying another logarithm.

endpoints.label: Overall survival
endpoints.event_definition: Death as encoded by the source Survival Status
